request.conditional_cache_headers: If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since rejected, request a fresh no-store body

scope: P08 history reads and P23 scan-sessions
NFC list/detail/events, not native confirmation receipt
Existing containers GET list/detail only with p18-single-warehouse-boxes-v1 header
native_receipts_binary_writes: Excluded. Never send this header on START/END/SAVE/SCAN/RECORD/PATCH/upload/logout/password commands or receipt/reconcile routes.

representation.meta.contract: explicit-read-fields-v1, not the nullable original owner schema
representation.meta.read_fields.owner_contract: Exact original owner contract if supplied, e.g. p12-mixed-documents-v3
representation.meta.read_fields.missing_fields: Array of JSON pointers plus status/source/value_supplied=false; no private values
representation.known: Known numbers, false, zero, strings, identities, empty arrays/objects and list order remain unchanged
representation.unknown: Absent value member plus explicit reason, never null, zero, empty string, Date.now, current-lookup historical data or fabricated identity
representation.unclassified: UNSPECIFIED_BY_OWNER explicitly identifies an unresolved owner/source gap; this is not a claim that the actual value was populated
representation.lists: A null list element fails 503, never removed/reindexed or replaced with a fake empty record
representation.partial_source: Missing total explained as PARTIAL_SOURCE; availableTotal stays distinct and is never substituted as total
representation.namespace: Existing meta.read_fields conflicts fail 503 instead of overwriting owner metadata

availability_rules.owner_declared: Prefer the exact sibling field_status/field_availability where supplied, preserving redaction/forbidden status
availability_rules.posted_at_reviewed_at: NOT_RECORDED, not derived from canonical status or current time
availability_rules.container_contents: Exact owner quantity_status; missing count is not zero
availability_rules.container_available_reserved: NO_AUTHORITATIVE_CONTAINER_AVAILABILITY_MODEL, not copied from warehouse balance/contained quantity
availability_rules.capacity_and_hierarchy: NOT_CONFIGURED in the actual single-warehouse-with-boxes model
availability_rules.p14_check_token: SERVER_BLOCKED only with can_end=false, no fabricated token
availability_rules.current_shift: NO_ACTIVE_SHIFT only from explicit owned-query admission state, never local CLEAN inference

preconditions.http_etag: Removed because original strong ETag does not validate transformed bytes
preconditions.meta.read_fields.owner_precondition.etag: Exact original owner literal including quotes/W/ when supplied; no reconstruction or stripping
preconditions.use: Original owner If-Match only; not an HTTP cache validator. Do not send the read representation header on the mutation.

compatibility: Without the header, nullable legacy owner contracts stay unchanged. FE/App must select and parse this representation explicitly, not pass it through the old strict nullable parser.
errors: Existing owner 401/403/404/409/503 stay errors, not empty success; successful response no-null policy does not rewrite owner error bodies or native receipts
